metadata.Name: Slovo
metadata.Description: A large-scale Russian Sign Language (RSL) video dataset containing 20,400 RGB videos for 1,000 sign language gestures. The videos were collected from 194 signers via crowdsourcing. The dataset is split into a training set (15,300 videos) and a test set (5,100 videos).
metadata.Venue Title: International Conference on Computer Vision Systems
metadata.Venue Name: International Conference on Computer Vision Systems
metadata.Abstract: One of the main challenges of the sign language recognition task is the difficulty of collecting a suitable dataset due to the gap between hard-of-hearing and hearing societies. In addition, the sign language in each country differs significantly, which obliges the creation of new data for each of them. This paper presents the Russian Sign Language (RSL) video dataset Slovo, produced using crowdsourcing platforms. The dataset contains 20,000 FullHD recordings, divided into 1,000 classes of isolated RSL gestures received by 194 signers. We also provide the entire dataset creation pipeline, from data collection to video annotation, with the following demo application. Several neural networks are trained and evaluated on the Slovo to demonstrate its teaching ability. Proposed data and pre-trained models are publicly available.
